item.dc:creator: Binbin Lu Bo Wu Guanpeng Dong Paul Harris a School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University, Wuhan, Chinab Net Zero and Resilient Farming, Rothamsted Research, North Wyke, UKc Department of Geography and Environment, Jiangxi Normal University, Nanchang, Jiangxi Province, Chinad Yellow River Civilization and Sustainable Development Research Center, Henan University, Kaifeng, Henan, ChinaBinbin Lu is a professor at Wuhan University. His research interests include geocomputation, spatial statistics and geographically weighted modelling. His contributions include conceptualization, methodology, resources, software, formal analysis, visualization, funding acquisition, writing – original draft, review & editing.Bo Wu is a professor at Jiangxi Normal University. His research interests include spatio-temporal data mining, intelligent remote sensing image processing, GeoAI, and spatial statistics. His contributions include methodology, validation, investigation and writing – review & editing.Guanpeng Dong is a professor at Henan University. His research interests include spatio-temporal statistics, climate change and GeoAI. His contributions include methodology and writing – review & editing.Paul Harris is a professor at Rothamsted Research. His research interests include environmental monitoring and modelling for agroecosystems over space and time, and recently focuses on developing analytical methods for resilient farming systems. His contributions include methodology, investigation, funding acquisition and writing – review & editing.

item.dc:title: Efficient computation for continuous Hausdorff and average Euclidean distance between polylines
item.dc:creator: Barry J. Kronenfeld Barbara P. Buttenfield Lawrence V. Stanislawski Ethan Shavers a Department of Geology and Geography, Eastern Illinois University, Charleston, USAb Department of Geography, University of Colorado, Boulder, USAc Center of Excellence for Geographic Information in Science, U.S. Geological Survey, Rolla, USABarry J. Kronenfeld is a Professor in the Department of Geology and Geography at Eastern Illinois University, Charleston, IL, USA. His research interests include cartographic generalization, spatial statistics and accessible computing/GIS. He contributed to conceptualization, algorithm development, writing-original draft, software development and validation.Barbara Buttenfield is Professor Emerita at the University of Colorado in Boulder, and Faculty Research Affiliate at U.S. Geological Survey’s Center for Excellence in Geospatial Science. Her research focuses on data modeling across scale and resolution, multi-scale geospatial database design, geovizualization and uncertainty analysis. She contributed to conceptualization, algorithm review, writing-review and editing.Lawrence (Larry) V. Stanislawski is a Research Cartographer for the U.S. Geological Survey National Geospatial Technical Operations Center. His research involves geospatial database development, multiscale cartography, and machine learning to support national mapping operations and resource management. He contributed to conceptualization, algorithm review, writing-review and editing.Ethan Shavers is a researcher and the Section Chief for the U.S. Geological Survey’s Center of Excellence for Geospatial Information Science (CEGIS). The focus of CEGIS is conducting research in support of The National Map, the Three-Dimensional Elevation Program (3DEP), and the 3D National Hydrography Program (3DHP). He contributed to conceptualization, algorithm review, writing-review and editing.
